title: Pay Operations Memorandum — Long-Route Credit on Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Adjustments
content:
When a mileage adjustment is approved on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, a long-route credit is added after the claimed amount has been multiplied by any share applying to it:

1. **0.75** when the batch's posted mileage pay is **3.00 or more** and the miles driven are **at least one and a half times** the estimated route;
2. **0.40** when the posted mileage pay is **3.00 or more** and the miles driven exceed the estimated route by **more than the batch type's mileage dispute tolerance** but stay **below one and a half times** it;
3. **nothing** otherwise.

The batch type's mileage dispute tolerance is 0 percent for the Shop-Only Batch and 15 percent for the Express 30 Batch, Single Delivery Batch, Double Delivery Batch, Triple Delivery Batch and Stock-Up Batch. The posted mileage pay is the total of the mileage pay components posted on the batch; the miles driven and the estimated route are those recorded on the batch.

## Worked cases (hypothetical Single Delivery Batch, estimated route 8.0 miles, tolerance 15 percent)

| Posted mileage pay | Miles driven | Test | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3.50 | 12.0 | 12.0 is at least 1.5 times 8.0 (12.0) | 0.75 |
| 3.50 | 11.9 | Above 9.2 (8.0 grown by 15 percent) and below 12.0 | 0.40 |
| 3.50 | 9.1 | Not more than 9.2 | Nothing |
| 2.95 | 13.0 | Posted mileage pay below 3.00 | Nothing |
